verses.1: And now, let those young men laugh at me. They are from my time; their ancestors were once like dogs who were used for hunting.
verses.2: What’s the use of their strength to me? They’ve lost all their power.
verses.3: In deficiency and in distortion, the demons are seen as evil beings who bring destruction and harm.
verses.4: The thorns cover the branches and roots of the plants.
verses.5: From Guev, they will be exiled; they will be punished like thieves.
verses.6: In the valley of Nehalim, there are caves where the eyes of Afar and Kefim rest.
verses.7: Among the shrubs, they will be destroyed under the weight of destruction.
verses.8: In the children of Nabal, and also in the children of Bally-Sham, they were taken up from the earth.
verses.9: And now, their music became my voice, and I became their leader.
verses.10: Please drive me away from here. Do not stay near me. They didn’t even stop by me.
verses.11: Because he opened the door for me, and he sent me away from my place.
verses.12: On the right side, flowers bloomed. Their legs moved forward, and they covered me with their petals.
verses.13: I have set my instructions for those who will follow them. They will not be able to help themselves.
verses.14: Like a vast expanse of land, it spread out under the weight of its own weight.
verses.15: Instead, I was pursued by a spirit of malice and hatred. My days were filled with suffering and pain.
verses.16: And now, let your soul participate with me; let it hold me in its embrace during my days of prosperity.
verses.17: That night, my hair fell from my head, and my clothes could not be put back on.
verses.18: With great effort, he will be able to overcome his difficulties. Then I will be able to protect him.
verses.19: I’ve turned it into wood, and I’ve shaped it like gold and silver.
verses.20: I will come to you, but do not refuse me. I will stand before you, and you shall respond to me.
verses.21: Be cruel to me at all times; but your hand will surely lift me up.
verses.22: Take me to your spirit, heal me, and purify me with your love.
verses.23: For I know that death will bring me back to life, and the house of mourning awaits me for all eternity.
verses.24: But he will not send his hand if he has to protect them from harm.
verses.25: If I don’t cry out for help today, then my soul will be filled with sorrow.
verses.26: For I had good, but then evil came. And I was lost in the darkness; it became worse and worse.
verses.27: They were taken away, and they did not come forward to face me on my days of glory.
verses.28: I went without any food, and I stood in the crowd, hungry.
verses.29: I was a rival and enemy of those who were young and innocent.
verses.30: My hair turned black from above, and my own hair also turned black from below.
verses.31: And it became a source of pain and suffering for those who heard its sound.
